summary.intent: Implement SDK-based E2E and load test suites as new workspace packages, replacing browser-dependent Playwright tests with direct SDK calls for faster, more reliable CI coverage.
summary.outcome: Created two new packages (`tests/sdk-e2e` with 83 passing tests across 10 suites, and `tests/load` with 5 load scenarios), implemented a throttle bypass mechanism for test environments, added two CI workflows, and resolved all 24 PR review comments.

repo: The `setApiClientConfig` in `packages/api-client/src/instance.ts` is a module-level singleton used by all orval-generated API functions — multi-account tests must call it serially with `switchTo()` to avoid cross-contamination
ThrottlerGuard is applied per-controller via `@UseGuards()`, not globally — individual endpoints also have `@Throttle()` decorators with stricter limits (IPNS publish: 10/min, test-login: 5/15min)
NestJS ConfigModule loads `.env` files which override `process.env` — setting `NODE_ENV=test` externally is ineffective if `.env` contains `NODE_ENV=development`
The `POST /auth/test-login` endpoint returns `{ accessToken, refreshToken, isNewUser, publicKeyHex, privateKeyHex }` and is the CI auth bypass pattern for SDK tests

Unit test specs use `.overrideGuard(ThrottlerGuard)` from `@nestjs/throttler` — when controllers import a custom guard aliased as `ThrottlerGuard`, the override targets the wrong class and causes DI failures
The pnpm workspace has three groups: `apps/*`, `packages/*`, `tests/*` — new test packages must be added to `pnpm-workspace.yaml`
Orval generates standalone functions that import `customInstance` from a module-level singleton rather than accepting an axios instance — this is a design gap, not a technical requirement
The IPFS `crypto.getRandomValues()` has a 65,536 byte hard limit per call — generating files larger than 64KB requires chunked generation

code.finding: Module-level singleton `_config` with `setApiClientConfig`/`getApiClientConfig` — all orval-generated functions read from this, making parallel multi-account SDK operations impossible without serialization
Reference pattern for test-login → vault init → CipherBoxClient — the gold standard extracted into the new test harness
New BypassableThrottlerGuard extends ThrottlerGuard, checks X-Throttle-Bypass header against THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET with constant-time comparison, guards with NODE_ENV !== 'production'

workflow: When replacing an NestJS guard class with a custom subclass in controllers, all test specs using `.overrideGuard(OldClass)` must be updated to `.overrideGuard(NewClass)` — the DI error message `can't resolve dependencies... THROTTLER:MODULE_OPTIONS` is the symptom
Load test workloads need try/catch around every `metrics.measure()` call — it re-throws after recording, so uncaught errors kill the entire workload function silently
1Password SSH agent is not accessible to background bash tasks spawned by Claude — commits from background tasks time out on signing; foreground commits work fine
Running `pnpm --filter <package> dev` for NestJS respects env vars only from `.env` files, not from the shell environment used to launch it

friction: The `NODE_ENV=test` approach to relax throttle limits was dead on arrival because NestJS ConfigModule's `.env` loading overrides the shell env — wasted a cycle before discovering the bypass header was the right approach
Multiple rounds of sed/Edit corruption on vault-lifecycle.test.ts from chained `fetchHeaders` → revert edits — required a full file rewrite to recover
1Password SSH agent unavailable to background tasks caused repeated commit hangs requiring manual intervention
The `crypto.getRandomValues()` 65536-byte limit caused silent load test failures — all clients rejected with 0 ops before the first measurement, with errors swallowed by `Promise.allSettled`
Orval's `customInstance` singleton pattern caused `setApiClientConfig` to be overwritten during multi-account tests, causing 401s in later suites — required per-suite re-set workaround
open_items: Refactor api-client from module-level singleton to instance-scoped axios — tracked in `.planning/todos/pending/2026-03-22-refactor-api-client-from-singleton-to-instance-scoped-axios.md`; eliminates `testFetch`, `switchTo()`, `setApiClientConfig` re-sets, and `defaultHeaders` workarounds

Investigate throttle bypass gap for per-endpoint `@Throttle()` decorators — tracked in `.planning/todos/pending/2026-03-22-investigate-throttle-bypass-gap-for-per-endpoint-throttle-decorators.md`; IPNS publish has 10/min limit causing load test 429s
Raw `fetch` calls in vault-lifecycle, share-operations, and invite-link test suites should be migrated to the generated orval API client functions — natural follow-on to the singleton refactor

Load test scenarios currently don't fail CI on high error rates — intentional design but a threshold-based failure mode (e.g., >50% errors fails the run) would make them more useful as regression guards
The `tests/TESTING_STRATEGY.md` documents the tiered throttle strategy and horizontal scaling implications — should be reviewed when production multi-node setup is being planned
